# ghost/block-night

Block Night (F-Droid) falling-blocks puzzle: start the first floor, drop pieces by drag/rotate/swipe, read pieces left and lines cleared. Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/block-night
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/block-night start_floor --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/block-night play_pieces --device <serial> --param shifts=<shifts>
ghost skill run ghost/block-night drop_piece --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/block-night hold_piece --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/block-night get_progress --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `start_floor`: Start the first floor in Block Night
- `play_pieces`: Start Block Night and drop three pieces
- `drop_piece`: Drop the current Block Night piece two cells to the right
- `hold_piece`: Hold the current Block Night piece
- `get_progress`: How is my Block Night floor going?
